prose.text:
Container images built from Dockerfiles:

| Dockerfile | Builds |
|---|---|
| `.devcontainer/Dockerfile` | Dev container |
| `apps/meteor/.docker-mongo/Dockerfile` | Main application |
| `apps/meteor/.docker/Dockerfile.alpine` | Main application |
| `apps/meteor/.docker/Dockerfile.debian` | Main application |
| `ee/apps/account-service/Dockerfile` | Service: account-service |
| `ee/apps/authorization-service/Dockerfile` | Service: authorization-service |
| `ee/apps/ddp-streamer/Dockerfile` | Service: ddp-streamer |
| `ee/apps/omnichannel-transcript/Dockerfile` | Service: omnichannel-transcript |
| `ee/apps/presence-service/Dockerfile` | Service: presence-service |
| `ee/apps/queue-worker/Dockerfile` | Service: queue-worker |

Docker Compose stacks define multi-container topologies:

| Compose file | Services |
|---|---|
| `development/docker-compose-monitoring.yml` | `init`, `tempo`, `otel-collector`, `agent`, `prometheus`, `grafana` |
| `docker-compose-ci.yml` | `rocketchat`, `authorization-service`, `account-service`, `presence-service`, `ddp-streamer-service`, `queue-worker-service`, `omnichannel-transcript-service`, `nats`, `mongo`, `httpbin`, `traefik`, `openldap` |
| `docker-compose-local.yml` | `rocketchat`, `authorization-service`, `account-service`, `presence-service`, `ddp-streamer-service`, `queue-worker-service`, `omnichannel-transcript-service`, `mongo`, `nats`, `traefik` |
| `ee/packages/federation-matrix/docker-compose.test.yml` | `traefik`, `hs1`, `rc1`, `mongo`, `element` |
_No Helm charts in this repo (deployed via external chart / Docker)._
